text:
elaine: Opening a tiny PR to clarify Optimize prefetch semantics in our JS snippet and to fix a kv-cache edge-case in the example. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4890 
omar: Thanks. Can you paste the JS snippet here so I can check the cache semantics?
elaine: Pasted in PR, but short excerpt: `const client = new PrefetchClient(); client.prefetch({route: '/chat', prefixes: ['user:123']}).catch(err => console.warn(err));` Explanation notes that prefetch is advisory and doesn't create prefixes server-side.
dev-docs-bot: checklist: [x] PR opened, [ ] reviewer assigned, [ ] snippets linted, [ ] links validated
omar: Two quick things: 1) we renamed OldKVCache->KVCacheManager in SDK last release, ensure snippet reflects that. 2) mention fallback variant when prefix missing.
elaine: Updated snippet to `new KVCacheManager()` and added fallback note: "If prefix not present, runtime falls back to pinned variant (v1-small)."
link-bot: link-check: found one internal anchor mismatch (/docs/optimize/kv-cache -> /docs/optimize/cache/kv).
elaine: Fixed anchor to /docs/optimize/cache/kv and updated PR.
ci-bot: md-lint passed, snippets/js-format failed (prettier)
elaine: Running prettier locally and pushing fix.
(1 min)
ci-bot: snippets/js-format passed, link-check passed
dev-docs-bot: checklist: [x] PR opened, [x] reviewer assigned (omar), [x] snippets linted, [x] links validated
omar: Quick wording nit: instead of "prefetch is advisory" say "prefetch is advisory: it improves cold-start hit rates but does not create durable prefixes". Also add a tiny reproducibility bullet for the perf note.
elaine: Done. Added perf bullet: - hw: T4 - batch: 4 - seq: 1024 - observed: ~14ms/token with ~78% prefix hit (qprof-small-int8). Kept it short.
omar: Code lgtm. One more: show `await client.close()` in example to avoid leaked connections in snippets.
elaine: Added `await client.close()` and switched to `try/finally` pattern. Pushed commit.
ci-bot: all checks green, deploy preview: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/optimize/prefetch-kv-edgecase-fix
omar: Smoke looks good. Examples render and code highlight OK.
dev-docs-bot: merging after green CI.
elaine: Merged & deployed to prod. Thanks! This should reduce confusion about prefetch semantics and reduce a handful of support tickets. :sparkles:
